questions.question: In a circular garden of radius 15 m, a path of 2 m wide has to be made inside the garden at the rate of ₹ 24 per sq. m. The cost of making the path is: (Take π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Circular garden of radius 15 m.

 A path of 2 m wide has to be made inside the garden at the rate of Rs. 24 per sq. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2dc14252966397dc56e5603e15e0e15425f01995b6042579ba7764d8b8fbb1d.png] 

**Formula used:**

Area of Garden = Π(R² – r²)

**Calculation:**

R = 15 m

r = (15 – 2) = 13 m

**According to the question:**

Area of Garden = Π(R2 – r2)

⇒ 22/7 × (15² – 13²)

⇒ 22/7 × (225 – 169)

⇒ (22/7) × 56

⇒ 22 × 8 = 176 cm²

Total cost = 24 × 176 = Rs. 4224

**∴ The cost of making the path is Rs. 4224. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Option method:- **

We know that the cost of making the path is always divisible on 11 (because of 22/7). 

If the number of digits of a number is even, then add the first digit

and subtract the last digit from the rest of the number.

We can clearly see that there is only one option(3) that is performing

the divisibility rule of 11.{ (4 + 2) - ( 2 + 4 ) = 0}

questions.question: The mode of a distribution is 24 and the mean is 60. What is its median?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mode = 24

Mean = 60

**Formula used:**

Mean - Mode = 3(Mean - median)

**Calculation:**

Let Median be x.

(60 - 24) = 3(60 - x)

⇒ 36/3 = (60 - x)

⇒ 12 = (60 - x)

⇒ 60 - 12 = x

⇒ x = 48

**∴ The median is 48.**

questions.question: If 50% of a certain number is equal to (3)/(4)th of another number, what is the ratio between the numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

50% of a certain number is equal to (3)/(4)th of another number.

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be x and y.

According to the question:

(50% of x) = [(3/4) × y]

⇒ 50x/100 = 3y/4

⇒ x/2 = 3y/4

⇒ x/y = 3/2

⇒ x : y = 3 : 2

**∴ The ratio between the numbers are 3 : 2.**

questions.question: A hollow cylinder with outer radius 4 cm and height 2 cm is made up of 1 cm thick metal sheet. What is the volume of metal used? (Take π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The outer Radius of the hollow cylinder is 4 cm.

Height is 2 cm.

Thick is 1 cm. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7b2d8ac61b7489f2c221d518a3459a194e4617a4791eecd42b30d18911cb04d.png] 

**Formula used:**

The volume of hollow cylinder = Outer Volume – Inner Volume 

= πR²h – πr²h 

**Calculation:**

Outer Radius(R) = 4 cm

Inner Radius(r) = (4 – 1) cm = 3 cm.

According to the question:

πR2h – πr2h 

⇒ πh(R² – r²)

⇒ (22/7) × (4² – 3²) × 2

⇒ (22/7) × 7 × 2

⇒ 44 cm³

 **∴ The volume of metal used is 44 cm³. ** **
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Option Method:- **

we can clearly see that there is only one option(3) that is performing the divisibility rule of 11 (4 × 11 ).

questions.question: The ratio of time taken by A and B to cover a certain distance is 7 : 9. The ratio of their respective speed will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of time taken by A and B to cover a certain distance is 7 : 9

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Time is inversely proportional to speed.

The ratio of time is 7: 9

**∴ The ratio of speed is 9 : 7.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper organizes sale on Friday, offering a discount of 23% on all items. Still, he makes a profit of 10% only. By how much percentage CP was lower than MP?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount percentage = 23%

Profit percentage = 10%

**Concept used:**

CP/MP = (100 – Discount%)/(100 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

CP/MP = (100 – 23)/(100 + 10)

⇒ CP/MP = 77/110

⇒ CP/MP = 7/10

MP – CP = 10 – 7 = 3

⇒ (3)/({10)} times 100 = 30\% 

**∴ Required percentage is 30%**

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio 6 : 4 : 3 and its perimeter is 104 cm. The length of the longest side (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the sides of a triangle is 6 : 4 : 3

The perimeter of the triangle = 104 cm

**Concept:**

The perimeter of a triangle = sum of the length of all the sides of a triangle

**Calculation:**

Let sides are 6x cm, 4x cm and 3x cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/068ac66ab7c3a3b43a73a8deaee4b2e9d96ec8f30bfbdc9156706a56ebefabba.png] 

6x + 4x + 3x = 104 cm

⇒ 13x = 104 cm

⇒ x = 8

⇒ 6x = 48

**∴ The length of the longest side is 48 cm**

questions.question: In a family of 4 adults and some minors, the average consumption of rice per head per month is 8.5 kg, while the average consumption for adults is 10 kg per head and for minor it is 5.5 kg per head. The number of minors in the family is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

There are 4 adults and the consumption of rice per month = 10 kg per head.

The average consumption of rice per head per month is 8.5 kg.

The average consumption for adults is 10 kg per head and for minor it is 5.5 kg per head.

**Solution:**

Let the number of minors be x.

Number of adults = 4

Total consumption of adults = 4 × 10 kg = 40 kg

Total consumption of minors = 5.5 × x = 5.5x kg

According to the question:

(40 + 5.5x)/(4 + x) = 8.5

⇒ 40 + 5.5x = 34 + 8.5x

⇒ 40 – 34 = 8.5x – 5.5x

⇒ 3x = 6

⇒ x = 2

 **∴ The number of minors in the family is 2.**

questions.question: Two adjacent sides of a parallelogram are 12 cm and 9 cm and one of the angle is 30° . Find the area of parallelogram.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two adjacent sides of a parallelogram are 12 cm and 9 cm.

And one of the angle is 30°

**Formula used:**

Area of parallelogram = ab × sinθ 

Where, a and b are two adjacent sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/797d6868ba601236be697d81d1f754c12c5a1b9ac7ee807dc8545c2b955f7aa5.png] 

**Calculation:**

a = 12 cm

b = 9 cm 

θ = 30° 

Area of parallelogram = ab × sinθ 

⇒ 12 × 9 × sin30° = 12 × 9 × (1/2)

⇒ 6 × 9 =54 cm²

**∴ The area of parallelogram is 54 cm².**
